lookup.dp.synFoot: AI Storage persistently writes KV Cache; when a request shares the same prefix, storage recalls from the multi-tier cache and skips full Prefill. At 128K input / 1K output, TTFT drops from 9100 ms to 4400 ms (−52%); 100% of compute goes to Decode.
lookup.dp.cloudPara: 08:00–22:00: multi-user elastic inference scales with load; NPU utilization tracks demand and scales on demand at peak. 22:00–08:00: idle inference capacity seamlessly switches to training. Traditional siloed training/inference servers leave racks idle half the day—combined utilization below 30%. Compute–cloud synergy keeps the same hardware in a 50–80% band, an uplift of 2× or more.
lookup.dp.cloudParaBoot: Boot state: mobile banking and risk control occupy racks 1–2 and 3–4; Scenario 3 AI Coding spans two large-EP groups on racks 5–8 and 9–12 (64×NPU · DeepSeek V4-Flash each). HCS+ModelArts load-balances by scenario for multi-model coexistence and isolation.
lookup.dp.cloudParaScale: Elastic scheduling: when mobile-banking traffic rises, ModelArts prioritizes reloading racks 5–8 as Qwen-32B for the surge; Scenario 3 AI Coding shrinks to racks 9–12. Versus Feature 1 boot state, the same AI racks are reallocated without adding hardware.
